questions.answer: Their politeness, the culture of eating out, the Izakaya culture

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer:
1. Think hard about where you choose your accommodation
2. Travel around
3. Go out and eat every day, you wont get that chance again any time soon

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
questions.answer: Dont live on campus if you want to go out and explore Tokyo

questions.answer: Adapting to another country
